rates.label: APOR (average prime offer rate, used by federal regulators)
rates.source: FFIEC / CFPB Average Prime Offer Rates, fixed-rate table (weekly)
rates.licence: public domain (US federal work). CFPB Website Privacy Policy and Legal Notices (https://www.consumerfinance.gov/privacy/website-privacy-policy/): "Information created by the CFPB is in the public domain and you may reproduce, publish, or otherwise use it without the Bureau's permission."
rates.note: APOR is the benchmark regulators use for HMDA rate spreads and QM/HPML tests; it is an average prime offer, not a quote. Computed by the CFPB from a commercial rate survey; only the published APOR values are used.
